fix(config): the effort gauge evaluates max's climbing colour only where it draws it, so a still rung never claims to move (candybar-animation-wbxz.014)

A stepped colour tells the frame its next change when it is evaluated, drawn
or not. The gauge computed max's climbing colour at every level, so the
bundled bar at any effort below max reported motion: the doctor called it
moving, and a feed at 5x or 20x redrew it at that beat. Max's colour and
frames now sit in max's branch; the bubble is still computed at every level.

Also renames the feed's clamped on-screen period, which read as a boolean.

fix(feed): the viewer over a moving bar is drawn as the still text it is, and a wake's timer is set from one wall reading (candybar-animation-wbxz.014)

- The diagnostics viewer takes the body's place, so the body's next change is
  the viewer's (never) rather than the hidden bar's beat; a feed no longer
  redraws an open viewer 30 times a second.
- `arm` measures its wait from the caller's wall reading, so `hasten` no longer
  rebuilds its due instant from a second, truncated one.
- A test pins the closing flash's start and turns to the same host instant at
  1x, 5x and 20x.
- The rendering memory line names the concept, not the template functions.

feat(feed): a frame is drawn when the bar next changes, not at a fixed 30 fps (candybar-animation-wbxz.014)

A feed chose between two fixed periods by whether its last frame moved, so
a 1 s template `frames` was drawn 30 times a second with 29 frames dropped
as repeated bytes. Every animation a frame draws now says when it next
changes on one host clock, and the feed draws the next frame then: no
closer than its spacing, no further apart than the still period.

- The session's animation clock is a rich-js Timeline. Templates' `frames`
  and `stepped` run through it and stamp their holds on wall time; the
  draw hears the holds of functions that stamp no cell (onHold).
- Each effect part carries the timeline it counts on: loops and passages
  the session's, the closing flash the host clock at rate 1. The flash is
  one animation over the idle period, so a frame announces its start.
- A row's and a frame's `nextChange` replace the `moves` boolean; motion
  is read off that one value.
- The feed owns the instant each frame is drawn for, kept within the
  timer's resolution of the wall clock, so a frame set for a change shows
  it however its timer fires.
- The rate cell shows the feed's ceiling, `≤30 fps` / `≤1 fps`.

refactor(config): a config layer carries its own scope, not a parallel repoLayers list (candybar-plugins-vf6g.chl) (#504)

* refactor(config): a config layer carries its own scope, not a parallel repoLayers list (candybar-plugins-vf6g.chl)

Each chain layer is {path, scope}, the scope decided once where discovery
finds the file. repoLayers is gone from the resolution, the durable home,
the session, the render cache's chain and its load key, and the loader
reads layer.scope instead of testing path membership. Hand-built chains
(check's explicit file, demo, gallery, bench, the durable writer's home)
state the user's scope through one helper, homeLayer.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(config): check reports scoped layers, and a load reports the chain it loaded (candybar-plugins-vf6g.chl)

Review: the check outcome dropped each layer's scope, so callers rebuilt a
different chain from it; an explicit check took its layer by hand instead of
the resolution's; the load frame carried a second copy of the chain's paths.

## [1.167.1](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.167.0...v1.167.1) (2026-10-30)

### Bug Fixes

* **colour:** the door's open ✖ wears the theme's text-red, so it reads on its activated ground (candybar-joiners-e5r4.i30) ([#503](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/503)) ([e03723c](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/e03723ccfd5e2ed7bcd921e08ab6228dc1949671))

test(colour): the door's ✖ at a lower depth is held on the rung the depth presses it into (candybar-joiners-e5r4.686)

At 256 colours and ansi the door's ground is the pressed shade at that
depth, which moves along the ladder where the depth draws the dial's rung
like what stands beside the door. Where the ground is the truecolor one
rounded, rounding never costs the ✖ the contrast it has at truecolor, as
before. On another rung the ✖ stands as far off as the door's rule puts a
red there at truecolor: the text floor where a named red clears it, else
the farthest of them. The looks at a lower depth are the first to reach
each ground the depth gives the door, and each ground is held to its name.

The listing of grounds no named red clears, regenerated from the rendered
bar at truecolor, is unchanged: no truecolor ground moves.

fix(colour): a dial window holds only the rungs the depth draws distinct, and no seam on the bundled bar joins one colour (candybar-joiners-e5r4.686)

A cell's shade is selected from its hue's window at the depth drawn: the
dial position's tones the depth draws as distinct colours, by identity
after rounding (rich-js drawnColour), widened along the ladder to the
nearest rung drawn apart where the depth draws them all as one. A pressed
shade (the activated trigger, its band's leads and ✕) is the dial's
activated rung widened by the same function until it draws apart from its
band's items, its trigger's neighbours and the press a depth up. Both are
memoised per palette and read by entryOf as before.

The closing sweep renders every bundled theme at truecolor, 256 and ansi,
closed and on each settings tab, through the session rig, and holds every
seam to two grounds drawn as two colours. One seam reader in test/helpers
serves the sweep, colour-256 and the theme-identity audit.
fix(test): the log line is spelled once, and a timed-out click's event waits on the click's reply budget (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)
fix(test): a log read judges only whole lines, the reporter pairs each failure with its own block, and the click stand-in leaves no timer behind (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)
fix(test): a failure jest would print blank names its message and the file it landed in (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)
fix(test): a click answered TIMEOUT takes its outcome from the daemon's click event, and is never sent twice (brandon-unfiled-3248.cuvv)
